# `dist/github-action/` — committed GitHub Action bundle

This directory holds the **reproducibly built, committed** runtime bundle that
the root [`action.yml`](../../action.yml) executes with the `node24` runtime
(VF16, VF17, D19). GitHub Marketplace consumers run this bundle directly, so it
is checked in rather than built on the fly.

- **Source:** `packages/action-github` (thin `@actions/core` adapter over the
  shared core in `packages/core`).
- **Build:** produced by `npm run build` (`scripts/build.mjs`) and verified by a
  `dist`-integrity check that fails the build if the committed tree does not
  match a clean rebuild file-for-file (supply-chain hardening, D18).

Both `index.js` and this `README.md` are generated by `scripts/build.mjs` so the
exact-tree integrity gate reproduces the whole directory. `index.js` is currently
a **placeholder stub** that fails fast; the adapter and its real bundle are wired
in a later epic (E3).
